abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.
abstract_zh: 前沿市场（FM）地位是低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的垫脚石。自这一概念三十多年前首次提出以来，前沿市场已获得显著的投资吸引力，尤其是在2008年全球金融危机之后。与此同时，从新冠疫情开始的近期一系列全球冲击凸显了这些国家持续存在的脆弱性。本文旨在通过提供关于前沿市场地位决定因素的新分析，并利用动态国家样本，考察帮助低收入国家获得及失去前沿市场地位的因素，从而加深我们对前沿市场的理解。研究发现，构建稳健的宏观经济基本面并确保良好治理是成为前沿市场的关键。此外，本文还指出，灵活的汇率制度、充足的官方储备缓冲以及相对较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低前沿市场主权利差对全球金融状况变化敏感性的关键因素。
title: Frontier Markets: Analyzing Drivers of Market Growth and Sovereign Risks
title_zh: 前沿市场：市场增长驱动因素与主权风险分析

abstract: This paper revisits the predictive power of asset prices for inflation, focusing on individual stock prices rather than aggregate indices. Using a large panel data of firm-level stock prices and applying machine learning techniques, we demonstrate that individual stock prices significantly enhance the accuracy of inflation forecasts, particularly over medium- to long-term horizons and during periods of high inflationary and deflationary pressure. Compared to composite and industry-level stock indices, other aggregate asset prices, and Fama-French factors, individual stock prices contain valuable heterogeneous information, offering richer insights for inflation forecasting. These findings provide new empirical support for macro-finance theory, affirming the predictive value of asset prices from a micro-level perspective.
title: Do Asset Prices Help Predict Inflation? Evidence from Individual Stock Prices
title_zh: 资产价格能否预测通胀？来自个股价格的证据

abstract: We propose a flexible dual functional factor model for modelling high-dimensional functional time series. In this model, a high-dimensional fully functional factor structure is imposed on the observed functional processes, whereas a low-dimensional version (via series approximation) is assumed for the latent functional factors. We extend the classic principal component analysis technique for estimating a low-rank structure to the estimation of a large covariance matrix of random functions that satisfies a notion of (approximate) functional “low-rank plus sparse” structure; and generalize the matrix shrinkage method to functional shrinkage in order to estimate the sparse structure of functional idiosyncratic components. The developed methodology can be used to estimate both the functional contemporaneous covariance and lag-h autocovariance matrices. Under appropriate regularity conditions, we derive the large sample theory of the resulting estimators, including the consistency of the estimated factors and functional factor loadings and convergence rates of the estimated matrices of covariance and autocovariance functions measured by various (functional) matrix norms. Consistent selection of the number of factors and a data-driven rule to choose the shrinkage parameter are discussed. Simulation and empirical studies are provided to demonstrate the finite-sample performance of the developed model and estimation methodology.
title: Covariance Function Estimation for High-Dimensional Functional Time Series with Dual Factor Structures
title_zh: 双因子结构高维函数型时间序列的协方差函数估计

abstract: We consider a common correlated effects estimator for panel quantile regression models featuring heterogeneous slope coefficients and interactive fixed effects. Using convolution smoothing to facilitate the derivation of asymptotic properties, our method allows the number of time periods (T) to grow at a much slower rate than the number of cross-sectional units (N). We establish that the mean group estimator converges to a limiting normal distribution, which may have a nonzero mean in our asymptotic framework. To address biases from the smoothed objective function and a relatively small T, we introduce a two-step bias correction procedure. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the method’s validity in finite samples, and we apply it to analyze the sharp rise in demand for high-skilled workers in U.S. manufacturing.
title: CCE Estimation of Heterogeneous Panel Quantile Regression Models with Relatively Small T
title_zh: 相对较小T下异质性面板分位数回归模型的CCE估计

abstract: What is the impact of a prior banking relationship on a borrower’s incentives to avoid default? To answer this question, we exploit a unique institutional setting and data on 149,230 mortgage loans tracked for twenty four months. We find that the presence of a relationship diminishes borrower’s default risk by approximately 4%, attributable exclusively to the value of the relationship for the borrower. This effect persists during the notable surge in loan defaults during COVID-19 and is even more pronounced for borrowers affected by a natural disaster, as well as among wealthier and married male borrowers.
abstract_zh: 既有银行关系对借款人避免违约的激励有何影响？为解答此问题，我们利用独特的制度环境及追踪二十四个月的149,230笔抵押贷款数据。研究发现，关系的存在使借款人的违约风险降低约4%，这一效应完全归因于关系对借款人的价值。该效应在COVID-19期间贷款违约显著激增时依然持续，并且对于受自然灾害影响的借款人，以及较富裕和已婚男性借款人中更为显著。
title: Relationship banking: The borrower’s incentives channel
title_zh: 关系型银行：借款人的激励渠道

abstract: Since 2011, there has been a substantial decline in the number of students graduating from college with accounting majors. We help explain this decline by empirically showing that technological advancement is associated with lower relative demand from employers for accounting majors compared to other business majors, especially finance. Specifically, corporate software investment is associated with lower relative wages and employment for accounting majors. Cross-sectional tests point to these findings resulting from differences in demand for human capital associated with specific college majors. As the wage gap between finance and accounting majors widens, fewer students subsequently choose an accounting major and more choose a finance major, consistent with selection models going back to Roy (1951). Our findings illustrate the utility of incorporating human capital demand factors into analyses of accounting labor markets and their connection to college major choice.
abstract_zh: 自2011年以来，会计专业本科毕业生人数显著下降。我们通过实证研究帮助解释这一现象，表明技术进步与雇主对会计专业相对于其他商科专业（尤其是金融专业）的较低相对需求相关联。具体而言，企业软件投资与会计专业毕业生的相对工资和就业机会下降有关。横截面测试表明，这些发现源于对不同大学专业所对应人力资本需求的差异。随着金融与会计专业间工资差距扩大，选择会计专业的学生随之减少，而选择金融专业的学生增多，这与自Roy（1951）以来的选择模型相符。我们的研究结果凸显了将人力资本需求因素纳入会计劳动力市场分析及其与大学专业选择关联的实用性。
title: Technological investment and accounting: A demand-side perspective on labor markets and enrollments
title_zh: 技术投资与会计：劳动力市场与入学率的需求侧视角

abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.
abstract_zh: 投资者对改革进展给予回报。计量经济学结果表明，整体性改革、财政支出纪律和货币政策可信度与卡塔尔外部主权信用利差的收紧相关联。特别是，投资者可能将财政支出纪律视为卡塔尔整体改革和经济多元化不可或缺的一部分。更广泛的全面改革进展也增强了主权信用利差对外部冲击的韧性。研究结果支持将财政和货币政策改革作为更广泛改革议程的一部分，以整体方式推进，正如第三次国家发展战略所规划的那样。
title: Pricing Reform Progress: Evidence from Sovereign Spreads and Consensus Forecasts
title_zh: 定价改革进展：来自主权利差与共识预测的证据

abstract: Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 当努力程度不可观测，而研究者仅能观察到结合了努力与其他冲击的最终结果时，关于同伴效应对某项活动投入程度的影响研究往往面临挑战。例如在教育领域，GPA等学业成就指标既反映努力程度，也包含个体特有的GPA冲击。本文提出一种规避此类近似处理的新方法。我们的分析框架将不影响努力程度的不可观测GPA冲击与确实影响努力水平的偏好冲击进行区分。研究表明，当社交网络中存在孤立学生时，采用本方法获得的同伴效应估计值可能与经典方法（将努力程度近似处理）存在显著差异。通过将本方法应用于美国高中生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力程度代理变量的同伴效应估计值，比采用本方法获得的估计值低40%。
title: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
title_zh: 识别未观测努力与孤立学生网络中的同伴效应

abstract: We construct a continuous-time, monetary model with frictional goods and labour markets to revisit the long-run relationship between inflation and unemployment. By endogenising the value of consumers’ outside options and market power in accordance with standard consumer search theory, we generate novel predictions for the slope of the long-run Phillips curve, optimal monetary policy, and outcomes at the frictionless limit. The relationship between inflation and unemployment is non-monotone and, at low inflation rates, an increase in inflation reduces unemployment. The Friedman rule is suboptimal when firms’ average bargaining power across markets is low. Markups and markdowns vanish as frictions disappear.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们构建了一个包含摩擦性商品与劳动力市场的连续时间货币模型，以重新审视通胀与失业之间的长期关系。通过依据标准消费者搜寻理论内生化消费者外部选择价值与市场势力，我们为长期菲利普斯曲线的斜率、最优货币政策以及无摩擦极限下的结果提出了新的预测。通胀与失业之间的关系是非单调的，且在低通胀率下，通胀上升会降低失业率。当企业在各市场的平均议价能力较低时，弗里德曼规则并非最优。随着摩擦的消失，加成率与折价率也将消失。
title: Inflation and Unemployment in the Long Run Revisited
title_zh: 长期视角下通货膨胀与失业关系的再探讨

abstract: This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个货币政策正常化框架，其中流动性状况通过流动性渠道影响总需求。模型表明，即使在远离零利率下限的情况下，央行资产负债表操作也能稳定需求，使准备金与利率共同成为独立的政策工具。因此，最优资产负债表规模不仅取决于私人准备金需求，还取决于财政互动与流动性管理。在引发流动性陷阱的冲击发生后，最优政策在零利率下限扩大准备金，在加息启动前实施量化紧缩，并同步推进利率与准备金正常化，从而阐明资产负债表的稳定作用。
title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization
title_zh: 管理货币政策正常化

abstract: There are two major institutional investors in the syndicated loan market: collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and loan mutual funds. CLOs are closed-end funds while loan funds are open-end funds that issue claims that are redeemable on demand. In this paper, we examine whether CLOs provide arbitrage capital that contributes to the resilience of loan funds. We find that CLOs act as shock absorbers, providing liquidity through par-building trades when loan funds experience large outflows. However, CLO-provided liquidity is limited to par build–eligible loans, leading to potential flow-induced fire sales among par build–ineligible loans. (JEL G23, G38
abstract_zh: 摘要银团贷款市场中有两类主要机构投资者：担保贷款凭证（CLOs）和贷款共同基金。CLO属于封闭式基金，而贷款基金则是开放式基金，其发行的份额可随时赎回。本文考察CLO是否提供套利资本，从而增强贷款基金的韧性。研究发现，当贷款基金遭遇大规模资金外流时，CLO通过平价构建交易提供流动性，起到缓冲器作用。然而，CLO提供的流动性仅限于符合平价构建条件的贷款，这可能导致不符合条件的贷款因资金流动压力而被迫折价抛售。（JEL G23, G38）
title: Institutional Synergies and the Fragility of Loan Funds
title_zh: 制度协同与贷款基金的脆弱性

abstract: Quantum computation, a paradigm shift in computer science, has the potential to profoundly affect research in economics and finance. This special issue brings together a subset of papers that were presented at the conference. Quantum advantage has been demonstrated for payment systems and the first three papers cover such applications. The next set of papers cover asset pricing applications. The final one covers quantum data auction models.
abstract_zh: 量子计算，作为计算机科学领域的一次范式转变，有望深刻影响经济学与金融学的研究。本期特刊汇集了会议上展示的部分论文。量子优势已在支付系统中得到验证，前三篇论文即涵盖此类应用。接下来的论文涉及资产定价应用。最后一篇则探讨量子数据拍卖模型。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control Special Issue on Quantum Computing Applications in Economics and Finance
title_zh: 《经济动力学与控制杂志》量子计算在经济学与金融中应用专刊

abstract: Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。
title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计

abstract: This paper studies how demand curvature limits first-mover advantage and shapes surplus division in a Stackelberg duopoly facing α -concave demand for α ∈ [ − 1 , ∞ ) . Under constant symmetric marginal costs, I prove that across all possible equilibria, the leader-to-follower profit ratio is at least 1 + 5 + 4 α 2 . Thus, the leader is guaranteed to earn at least 61.8% more than the follower under log-concave demand ( α = 0 ) and at least twice as much under concave demand ( α = 1 ). Under demand with decreasing marginal revenue ( α = − 1 ), the leadership advantage persists. I further derive a lower bound for the leader’s profit alongside an upper bound for deadweight loss. Extremal demand curves D for which D α and ln D are affine attain all bounds for α > − 1 .
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在面临α-凹需求（α ∈ [ − 1 , ∞ )）的Stackelberg双头垄断中，需求曲率如何限制先发优势并塑造剩余分配。在恒定对称边际成本下，我证明在所有可能的均衡中，领导者与追随者的利润比率至少为1 + 5 + 4 α 2。因此，在对数凹需求（α = 0）下，领导者保证至少比追随者多赚61.8%；在凹需求（α = 1）下，则至少多赚两倍。在边际收益递减的需求（α = − 1）下，领导优势依然存在。我进一步推导了领导者利润的下界以及无谓损失的上界。对于α > − 1，满足D α和ln D为仿射函数的极值需求曲线D能达到所有界限。
title: The limits of leadership advantage in Stackelberg duopoly
title_zh: 斯塔克尔伯格双寡头中领导优势的局限性

abstract: This research aimed to evaluate Brazil's performance in achieving the goals and targets related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 13 (Climate Change) and SDG 15 (Life on Land), while systematically assessing how governmental actions align with the mitigation hierarchy (avoidance, minimization, restoration, offsetting, and enhancement). Based on a qualitative content analysis of scientific literature and official evaluation reports, this work contributes to the debate on climate change and biodiversity loss. The research identifies areas of progress and areas that still require attention from policymakers in this context. This study was developed with a qualitative approach and was structured in two stages, namely the scoping review and documentary research based on data retrieved the Institute of Applied Economic Research (IPEA), a foundation linked to the Brazilian Ministry of Planning and Budget. Documentary research identified reports evaluating Brazil's progress on SDG 13 and SDG 15, and document analysis revealed that Brazil has action plans with varying levels of achievement (fully achieved, partially achieved, and not achieved targets) related to biodiversity preservation, climate change mitigation, and sustainable development. Based on the Brazilian actions to mitigate impacts, it was possible to observe a hierarchy with a stronger emphasis on preservation (avoidance) compared to restoration actions, particularly in land management and biodiversity preservation. Furthermore, key points of progress and areas requiring attention from policymakers regarding this topic were also identified. In view of the need for progress in public policies focused on land management and on addressing climate change and biodiversity loss, this research advances the understanding of how integrated mitigation strategies can support the joint achievement of SDG 13 and SDG 15, offering a structured analytical framework to evaluate governmental performance and inform policy design.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估巴西在实现可持续发展目标（SDG）13（气候变化）与SDG 15（陆地生物）相关指标方面的表现，同时系统分析政府行动如何遵循减缓层级原则（避免、最小化、恢复、补偿与增强）。基于对科学文献及官方评估报告的定性内容分析，本研究为气候变化与生物多样性丧失的学术讨论提供了新见解。研究识别了该领域已取得的进展及仍需政策制定者关注的问题。本研究采用定性方法，分两个阶段展开：范围综述与文献研究，数据来源于巴西规划与预算部下属的应用经济研究所（IPEA）。文献研究识别了评估巴西在SDG 13与SDG 15进展的报告，文件分析表明，巴西在生物多样性保护、气候变化减缓及可持续发展方面制定了行动计划，但目标实现程度存在差异（完全实现、部分实现及未实现目标）。基于巴西减缓影响的具体行动，可观察到其减缓层级更强调保护（避免）而非恢复行动，尤其在土地管理与生物多样性保护领域。此外，本研究还识别了该议题下政策制定者需关注的进展关键点与待改进领域。鉴于土地管理、气候变化应对及生物多样性丧失治理领域公共政策亟需推进，本研究深化了对整合性减缓策略如何协同实现SDG 13与SDG 15的理解，为评估政府绩效及政策设计提供了结构化分析框架。
title: A land management, biodiversity preservation, and climate change mitigation analysis in Brazil
title_zh: 巴西土地管理、生物多样性保护与气候变化减缓分析

abstract: This paper provides new micro-level evidence on how labor taxation shapes firm behavior, exploiting an EU-mandated payroll tax reform in Norway. Combining administrative and survey data, we find that firms facing larger tax increases sharply cut employment but also increased R&D spending, implemented labor cost-saving innovations, and adopted more automation. While these responses led to improvements in labor and total factor productivity within the firm, the firm’s labor share fell. These effects persisted even after the tax hike was unexpectedly reversed three years later, suggesting a lasting shift toward more capital-intensive production in response to higher labor costs.
abstract_zh: 本文利用挪威一项欧盟强制实施的工资税改革，提供了关于劳动税收如何影响企业行为的新微观证据。结合行政与调查数据，我们发现，面临较大税负增加的企业大幅削减了就业，但同时增加了研发支出，实施了节约劳动力成本的创新，并采用了更多自动化措施。尽管这些反应带来了企业内部劳动生产率和全要素生产率的提升，但企业的劳动份额却下降了。这些效应在三年后税负意外逆转时依然持续存在，表明企业为应对更高的劳动力成本，已向更资本密集型生产方式发生了持久性转变。
title: Taxing Labor: Firm R&D, Automation and the Labor Share
title_zh: 征税劳动：企业研发、自动化与劳动份额

abstract: Rapid Re-Housing (RRH) programs provide short-term rental subsidies to help people experiencing homelessness secure market-rate housing. Using linked administrative data from Los Angeles County, we examine the causal effects of RRH on subsequent homelessness, as well as health, crime, public assistance, and labor market outcomes. We compare the outcomes of individuals and families who enrolled in an RRH program and received the subsidy (that is, leased up) to otherwise similar people who enrolled in the same RRH program in the same month but did not lease up. Participants who leased up received an average subsidy of $1500 per month for seven months, with families receiving more generous subsidies than individuals. Leasing up reduced homeless service use over four years by 30% for individuals and 25% for families, including reductions after the end of the subsidy period for both groups. Effects persisted for families, but faded out for individuals after three years. Likewise, leasing up improved health and criminal justice outcomes and increased income from public assistance programs for families, but not individuals. We find no evidence that leasing up reduced employment or earnings for either group based on statewide administrative data. The results indicate that short-term rental subsidies can meaningfully reduce homelessness, especially for families.
abstract_zh: 快速重新安置（RRH）项目提供短期租金补贴，以帮助无家可归者获得市场价住房。利用洛杉矶县的关联行政数据，我们考察了RRH对后续无家可归状况以及健康、犯罪、公共援助和劳动力市场结果的因果效应。我们将参与RRH项目并领取补贴（即成功租赁）的个人和家庭，与在同一月份参与同一RRH项目但未成功租赁的相似人群进行了比较。成功租赁的参与者平均每月获得1500美元的补贴，持续七个月，其中家庭获得的补贴比个人更为慷慨。成功租赁使四年内无家可归服务使用率在个人中降低30%，在家庭中降低25%，且两组在补贴期结束后仍呈现下降趋势。对家庭而言，效应持续存在，但对个人而言，三年后效应逐渐消退。同样，成功租赁改善了家庭的健康与刑事司法结果，并增加了来自公共援助计划的收入，但对个人无此影响。基于全州行政数据，我们未发现成功租赁对任一组的就业或收入产生负面影响的证据。结果表明，短期租金补贴能够显著减少无家可归现象，尤其是对家庭而言。
title: Does Rapid Re-Housing reduce homelessness?
title_zh: 快速安置住房能否减少无家可归现象？

abstract: This paper examines equilibrium strategies in adversarial bargaining, which are negotiations where one party demands concessions under threat of initiating a destructive conflict. We develop a multi-period model incorporating both endogenous conflict decisions and the risk of exogenous conflict, analyzing how outcomes depend on threat credibility and patience levels. Three types of equilibrium emerge: impatient aggressors extract the maximum concession through credible deterministic threats; highly patient scenarios feature probabilistic threats where exogenous risk creates bargaining power; and intermediate patience levels produce mixed-strategy threats. We distinguish between scenarios where conflict benefits the aggressor versus where conflict harms both parties, leading to brinkmanship. Our results reveal a striking non-monotonic relationship between patience and equilibrium demands when conflict benefits the aggressor.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了对抗性谈判中的均衡策略，此类谈判是指一方在威胁发动破坏性冲突的条件下要求对方让步的协商过程。我们构建了一个多期模型，同时纳入内生冲突决策与外生冲突风险，分析结果如何取决于威胁的可信度及耐心程度。均衡呈现三种类型：缺乏耐心的侵略者通过可信的确定性威胁获取最大让步；高度耐心的情境则涉及概率性威胁，其中外生风险赋予谈判筹码；而中等耐心水平则产生混合策略威胁。我们区分了冲突对侵略者有利与冲突对双方均有害的两种情形，后者导致边缘政策。研究结果显示，当冲突对侵略者有利时，耐心程度与均衡要求之间存在显著的非单调关系。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Adversarial bargaining with exogenous shocks
title_zh: 外生冲击下的对抗性谈判

abstract: We derive conditions for individual choices and $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium prices to be inferred from a finite set of market data in the following sense: Although potential observations are infinite, inference can be attained and known to have been attained after a finite number of observations. While we first examine the case of observations on an individual’s demand at different prices and incomes, our primary focus is on equilibrium, where only profiles of individual endowments and associated equilibrium prices are observable. Our main result is that finite inference is possible in the equilibrium setting if one wants to infer either individual choices or the $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium correspondence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文推导了从有限市场数据推断个体选择与ε-均衡价格的条件，其含义如下：尽管潜在观测数据是无限的，但经过有限次观测后，推断不仅能够实现，且可被确认为已完成。我们首先考察了不同价格与收入水平下个体需求观测的情形，但主要关注均衡状态——此时仅能观测到个体禀赋组合及其对应的均衡价格。核心结论是：若需推断个体选择或ε-均衡对应关系，则在均衡框架下有限次推断是可行的。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Exact inference from finite market data
title_zh: 有限市场数据的精确推断

abstract: This paper revisits the question of what core inflation is meant to represent and assesses the competing measures of core inflation that are available, including some new ones. I take the primary perspective that core inflation is a simple predictor of future headline inflation. There is evidence for ex food and energy, and other core measures, being superior predictors than headline inflation itself. Within choices of core inflation, simple averaging of different measures and different horizons seems to work best. I also consider some other concepts of core inflation: closeness to a common trend component and measurement of demand-driven inflation. The averaging estimator fares well by all of these metrics.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了核心通胀旨在代表什么的问题，并评估了可用的竞争性核心通胀衡量指标，包括一些新指标。我主要从核心通胀作为未来总体通胀的简单预测指标这一视角出发。有证据表明，剔除食品和能源后的核心通胀及其他核心指标，在预测能力上优于总体通胀本身。在核心通胀的选择中，对不同指标和不同时间跨度进行简单平均似乎效果最佳。我还考虑了核心通胀的其他概念：与共同趋势成分的接近程度以及需求驱动型通胀的衡量。平均估计量在所有这些指标上均表现良好。
title: What is core inflation?
title_zh: 什么是核心通胀？

abstract: Does a more persistent demand shock always generate a larger output response? Conventional wisdom says yes: forward-looking agents front-load spending in anticipation of higher lifetime resources, and the more lasting the shock, the stronger the expansion. This paper shows that this logic fails in New Keynesian models with an active monetary policy. The interplay between persistence and monetary policy stance governs a fundamental trade-off between two opposing forces: a permanent income channel that amplifies output, and a real interest rate channel that dampens it. Their balance generates three monetary policy regimes. In the empirically relevant intermediate regime, the output multiplier is hump-shaped in persistence.
abstract_zh: 更持久的需求冲击是否总会带来更大的产出响应？传统观点认为如此：前瞻性主体会因预期到终身资源增加而提前支出，且冲击持续时间越长，扩张效应越强。本文证明，在实施积极货币政策的凯恩斯模型中，这一逻辑并不成立。冲击持久性与货币政策立场之间的相互作用，主导着两种对立力量之间的根本权衡：放大产出的永久收入渠道与抑制产出的实际利率渠道。两者的平衡产生了三种货币政策体制。在具有经验相关性的中间体制中，产出乘数随持久性呈现驼峰形变化。
title: The Power of Persistence: How Demand Shocks and Monetary Policy Shape Macroeconomic Outcomes
title_zh: 持续的力量：需求冲击与货币政策如何塑造宏观经济结果

abstract: We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。
title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
title_zh: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法

abstract: A firm’s gross margin increases by 0.8 p.p.after forming a new direct board connection to a product market peer. Gross margin also rises by 0.4 p.p.after a connection is formed to a peer indirectly through a third intermediate firm. Further, using barcode-level data of 2.7 million products, we show that new board connections are related to higher consumer good prices, a greater tendency for market allocation, and slower new product introductions. The effects are stronger when the newly connected peers share corporate customers or have similar business descriptions and hold when controlling for other inter-firm relationships.
abstract_zh: 企业毛利率在与其产品市场同行建立新的直接董事会联系后上升0.8个百分点。通过第三方中间企业间接建立联系后，毛利率亦上升0.4个百分点。进一步，利用270万种产品的条形码级数据，我们发现新的董事会联系与更高的消费品价格、更强的市场分配倾向以及更慢的新产品推出速度相关。当新建立联系的同行共享企业客户或具有相似业务描述时，这些效应更为显著，并且在控制其他企业间关系后依然成立。
title: Board connections, firm profitability, and product market actions
title_zh: 董事会关联、公司盈利能力与产品市场行为

abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of wishful thinking that captures both the benefits and costs of optimistic biased beliefs and the behaviors they induce. Building on Bratcha and Brown (2012) and Caplin and Leahy (2019), we propose a two-stage framework in which a decision maker selects actions and belief structures under uncertainty, balancing subjective utility against the cost of departing from prior beliefs. The cost is formalized using a $$\phi $$ ϕ -divergence–based belief distortion function, encompassing measures such as Kullback–Leibler, reverse Kullback-Leibler, and Pearson $$\chi ^2$$ χ 2 distances. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we characterize optimal beliefs, showing they twist prior probabilities toward high-utility states across a broad class of divergences; (ii) we link WT behavior to risk-seeking actions via convex risk measures; and (iii) we introduce cognitive censoring and cognitive emergence, capturing extreme beliefs. Methodologically, the model provides new insights into how optimistic beliefs reshape decision-making, extending the theoretical foundations of WT and opening avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个易于处理的一厢情愿思维模型，该模型既捕捉了乐观偏差信念的收益与成本，也刻画了由此引发的行为。基于Bratcha和Brown（2012）以及Caplin和Leahy（2019）的研究，我们提出了一个两阶段框架：决策者在不确定性下选择行动与信念结构，在主观效用与偏离先验信念的成本之间进行权衡。该成本通过基于$$\phi $$-散度的信念扭曲函数形式化，涵盖Kullback-Leibler散度、逆Kullback-Leibler散度以及Pearson $$\chi ^2$$距离等度量。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）刻画了最优信念，表明在广泛的散度类别中，最优信念会将先验概率向高效用状态扭曲；（ii）通过凸风险度量将一厢情愿行为与风险寻求行动联系起来；（iii）引入认知审查与认知涌现概念，以捕捉极端信念。在方法论上，该模型为乐观信念如何重塑决策提供了新见解，拓展了一厢情愿思维的理论基础，并为未来研究开辟了方向。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Wishful thinking is risky thinking
title_zh: 一厢情愿是冒险的思维

abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data—digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information—we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network—and of who controls them.
abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演进的五个典型事实：全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低排名港口则呈现分散化趋势；同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们以这些事实为框架，系统梳理了快速发展的相关文献：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐射式集中格局（虽带来巨大但局部化的福利增益），将港口嵌入多式联运网络（放大基础设施投资回报），并催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本问题。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
title_zh: 港口、技术与城市间贸易：演变中的海运网络的经济学与地缘政治

abstract: We show that institutional portfolio rebalancing across asset classes plays a key role in transmitting monetary shocks to the stock market. Around FOMC announcements, ceteris paribus, a stock with 10-percentage-point higher ownership by rebalancing institutions experiences an additional 3.7-basis-point loss following a 10-basis-point surprise rate hike. We corroborate our mechanism by exploiting within-firm variations for dual shares, showing stronger price reactions at quarter- and month-ends when rebalancing is more imminent, and presenting placebo tests contrasting rebalancing institutions with other institutions. A concluding calibration suggests rebalancing could contribute roughly one-third to two-thirds of the aggregate stock market excess return response to monetary shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，机构投资者在资产类别间的组合再平衡在货币政策冲击向股市传导中扮演关键角色。在联邦公开市场委员会公告前后，在其他条件相同的情况下，若某只股票由进行再平衡的机构持有的比例高出10个百分点，则在利率意外上调10个基点时，该股票将额外损失3.7个基点。我们通过利用双重股份的公司内部差异来验证这一机制，显示在季度末和月末再平衡更为临近时，价格反应更为强烈，并通过对比再平衡机构与其他机构的安慰剂测试加以佐证。最终的校准分析表明，再平衡可能贡献了股票市场总体超额收益对货币政策冲击响应的约三分之一至三分之二。
title: Monetary transmission and portfolio rebalancing: A cross-sectional approach
title_zh: 货币传导与投资组合再平衡：一种横截面方法

abstract: Mitigating antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in veterinary medicine is critical to achieving the UN 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Most countries have adopted tailored antimicrobial reduction policies in animal production, yet rigorous cost-benefit evaluations remain scarce. We leverage China’s large-scale 2021 veterinary antimicrobial use reduction (AUR) policies as a quasi-natural experiment, employing a Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity (FRD) design to estimate its causal effects on farmers’ net income and disentangle the transmission mechanisms using three-wave panel data from hog farmers (2022–2024). The empirical results demonstrate that the AUR policies exhibited a dynamic pattern of initial income suppression followed by income enhancement, with the estimated effect turning positive in the second year of implementation (2023). Based on the baseline FRD estimates, the average effect over the full panel period is an increase of 186.504–198.708 CNY per head, representing 34.09 %–36.32 % of the three-year average net income. This effect is primarily driven by changes in cost-benefit indicators such as slaughter weight, market premiums, biosecurity expenditures, antimicrobial input costs, and antimicrobial alternative costs. We elucidate the underlying mechanisms through which AUR policy interventions operate, specifically via antimicrobial use regulation, compulsory immunization, antimicrobial-reduction compliance certification, and antimicrobial-reduction technical training. During the AUR’s initial rollout (2022), antimicrobial use regulation was the primary income suppressor, whereas market premiums became the dominant income driver in the maturation phase (2023–2024). Moreover, heterogeneity analysis shows that the income-enhancing effect of the AUR policies was more pronounced among farmers who possessed high digital literacy and had organizational support, compared to those without these advantages. Based onChina’s AUR experience, weproposefive policy insightsthat are particularly relevant fordeveloping-country contexts: optimized policy mixes, tiered biosecurity systems, scalable antimicrobial alternatives, targeted market incentives, and inclusive global governance frameworks.
abstract_zh: 减轻兽医学中的抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）对于实现联合国2030年可持续发展目标（SDGs）至关重要。大多数国家已在动物生产中采纳了定制化的抗菌药物减量政策，然而严格的成本效益评估仍然稀缺。我们利用中国2021年大规模兽用抗菌药物使用减量（AUR）政策作为准自然实验，采用模糊断点回归（FRD）设计，估计其对农户净收入的因果效应，并利用2022至2024年三轮生猪养殖户面板数据解析其传导机制。实证结果表明，AUR政策呈现出先抑制收入后提升收入的动态模式，估计效应在实施第二年（2023年）转为正。基于基线FRD估计，整个面板期间的平均效应为每头增加186.504至198.708元人民币，占三年平均净收入的34.09%至36.32%。这一效应主要由屠宰重量、市场溢价、生物安全支出、抗菌药物投入成本及抗菌药物替代成本等成本效益指标的变化驱动。我们阐明了AUR政策干预发挥作用的内在机制，具体通过抗菌药物使用监管、强制免疫、减抗合规认证及减抗技术培训实现。在AUR初期推行阶段（2022年），抗菌药物使用监管是主要的收入抑制因素，而在成熟阶段（2023至2024年），市场溢价成为主导的收入驱动因素。此外，异质性分析显示，AUR政策的收入提升效应在具备较高数字素养且获得组织支持的养殖户中更为显著，相较于不具备这些优势的养殖户。基于中国的AUR经验，我们提出五项对发展中国家情境尤为相关的政策启示：优化政策组合、分级生物安全体系、可推广的抗菌药物替代方案、精准市场激励以及包容性全球治理框架。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Assessing the economic effects of veterinary antimicrobial use reduction policies: China’s experience and worldwide implications
title_zh: 评估兽用抗菌药物减量政策的经济效应：中国经验与全球启示

abstract: Promoting green (usually more costly) product consumption is one essential element in building a sustainable society. In times of high inflation, not only budget constraints but also the fear that prices will continue to rise might limit the effectiveness of exerted efforts to promote sustainable behaviors. To test this suggestion, we conducted a Germany-wide survey with almost 1200 respondents, followed by a framed field experiment to confirm causality. Our proxy for green consumption is organic food purchases. Survey respondents’ stated organic purchasing behavior is positively correlated with concerns about climate change but negatively correlated with concerns about inflation. The latter result is driven by individuals with a below-median environmental attitude. In the framed field experiment, we use the priming method to manipulate the saliency of inflation concerns. Whereas sizably relaxing the budget constraint has no impact on the share of organic products in participants’ baskets, the priming significantly decreases the share of organic products for individuals with below-median environmental attitude. Using the same inflation priming in a subsequent survey experiment with around 1800 respondents, we find that high inflationary environments affect both the perception of organic being luxury products and the social norm of buying organic. Both effects are more pronounced for individuals with below-median environmental attitude and, hence, they are the likely mechanisms driving the negative effects on organic product consumption.
abstract_zh: 推广绿色（通常成本更高）产品消费是构建可持续社会的基本要素之一。在高通胀时期，不仅预算约束，而且对价格持续上涨的担忧，都可能限制促进可持续行为所付出努力的有效性。为验证这一观点，我们在德国开展了一项覆盖近1200名受访者的全国性调查，并随后进行了一项框架性实地实验以确认因果关系。我们以有机食品购买作为绿色消费的代理指标。调查受访者所报告的有机购买行为与对气候变化的担忧呈正相关，但与对通胀的担忧呈负相关。后者结果主要由环境态度低于中位数的个体驱动。在框架性实地实验中，我们采用启动方法操纵通胀担忧的显著性。尽管大幅放宽预算约束对参与者购物篮中有机产品的比例没有影响，但启动显著降低了环境态度低于中位数个体中有机产品的比例。在随后一项涉及约1800名受访者的调查实验中，使用相同的通胀启动，我们发现高通胀环境既影响有机产品被视为奢侈品的认知，也影响购买有机产品的社会规范。这两种效应在环境态度低于中位数的个体中更为显著，因此，它们可能是驱动有机产品消费负面效应的潜在机制。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Inflation concerns and green product consumption: Evidence from a nationwide survey and a framed field experiment
title_zh: 通胀担忧与绿色产品消费：基于全国性调查和框架田野实验的证据

abstract: This paper examines the implications of different forms of corruption, i.e., grand corruption, petty corruption, and cut-money culture, on the formulation and enforcement of regulatory policies. Focusing on quota regulation in the context of natural resource extraction, it demonstrates the following. In the absence of cut-money culture, petty corruption never occurs in equilibrium, irrespective of whether the policymaker is honest or corrupt. However, when the policymaker is corrupt, the threat of petty corruption leaves no room for grand corruption unless net environmental damage due to extraction is sufficiently discounted, in which case grand corruption occurs. In contrast, the presence of cut-money culture induces corruption, either petty or both grand and petty, in equilibrium. Cut-money culture may reduce the equilibrium quota from the ‘no petty corruption enforcing quota’; however, whenever this occurs, total extraction and environmental damage rise, and welfare declines. Our results have important implications for designing corruption control mechanisms and governing natural resource extraction.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了不同形式的腐败——即重大腐败、轻微腐败及“截留资金”文化——对监管政策制定与执行的影响。聚焦于自然资源开采背景下的配额监管，本文论证如下：在缺乏“截留资金”文化的情况下，无论政策制定者是否廉洁，均衡状态下均不会出现轻微腐败。然而，当政策制定者腐败时，除非开采造成的净环境损害被充分折现，否则轻微腐败的威胁使得重大腐败无隙可乘；在此折现条件下，重大腐败则会发生。相反，“截留资金”文化的存在会在均衡中诱发腐败，无论是轻微腐败还是重大与轻微腐败并存。这种文化可能将均衡配额降至“无轻微腐败执行配额”之下；然而，每当这种情况发生时，总开采量与环境损害上升，社会福利下降。我们的研究结果对设计反腐败控制机制及管理自然资源开采具有重要意义。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Quota regulation under corruption – Grand, petty and the cut-money culture
title_zh: 腐败下的配额管制——大额、小额腐败与“抽成”文化
